label: figjam-builder states the limitation the packet layout rule assumes: generative diagram tools optimize for compactness, not breathing room, so when the flow matters hand-build it or accept the limitation.
figjam-builder carries a board-quality grammar the packet lacks: eleven principles, three palette tiers with a job per tier, paired type roles and a fourteen-item audit pass.
The audit pass names the check the packet read-back needs: trace every required edge source-to-target, because neither a connector count nor a collision-free bounding box proves clarity.

figjam-builder documents a large-board reading ladder: get_figjam first, then child ids, metadata batches of about 30, 4-6 parallel screenshots and halving the batch on timeout, the opposite first move from the packet node-by-node rule.

figjam-builder documents the section-local coordinate trap, where adding section.x to a child doubles the offset, and the upload_assets 5-per-call 10-minute limit; the packet hybrid path documents neither.

Two corpus sources converge on the same board constants: 4px spacing, Inter only, white wrapper section, 60-92px tight, 200-400px loose and 1000px+ zone breaks; the packet has none of these because it never places a wrapper.

mermaid-jam exposes journey, mindmap, timeline and markdown userflow kinds plus sequence-to-cards, with explicit diagnostics for pie, gantt, ERD and class; this is the first evidence public FigJam work covers more kinds than the hosted generator.

mermaid-jam preserves manually moved node positions during updates when ids match and offers a rules-based Revise cleanup; the packet forbids moving generated nodes and has no automated model cleanup.

mermaid-jam gives line-level diagnostics before generation and always wraps output in a FigJam section; the packet matches diagnostics but has no section wrapper, so its diagrams cannot move as one unit.

tmcw figjam-mermaid runs the reverse direction the packet never runs: stickies and connectors become a Mermaid flowchart, except filled-triangle arrows, with no support for other element kinds or selection-only export.

The packet measured contrast gate remains stronger than the corpus palette systems: figjam-builder gives hex values and tiers but no contrast measurement, while the packet records 4.5:1 and 3.0:1 gates plus departures.
